An '''extended vibroblade''' was a type of [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]]. A member of an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] team dispatched to [[Teloc Ol-sen]] to acquire a number of [[Bergruutfa/Legends|bergruutfas]] wielded an extended vibroblade. When the team met the [[Zulirian Swordmasters]], [[Kaltor Naklian]] challenged the wielder to a duel. When the challenge was refused, Naklian slew the Rebel. The Alliance team retaliated but were cut down by the Swordmasters.
